title: Must the unit be photographed after possession returns and again after the repairs or cleanings, and when?

source.quote: Beginning April 1, 2025, the landlord shall take photographs of the unit within a reasonable time after the possession of the unit is returned to the landlord, but prior to any repairs or cleanings for which the landlord will make a deduction from or claim against the security deposit pursuant to this section, and shall also take photographs of the unit within a reasonable time after such repairs or cleanings are completed.

children.statement: Possession was returned on or after April 1, 2025.
